newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Old Mutual buys Axa Equity offshore unit.
newsitem.headline: Old Mutual buys Axa Equity offshore unit.

text.p: South Africa's biggest life insurer Old Mutuual said on Friday its Old Mutual International Group unit had bought the Isle of Man-based offshore operations of Axa Equity & Law.
Axa Equity & Law is a British subsidiary of French insurer Axa.
An Old Mutual spokesman declined to give the exact terms of the deal, but said the acquired operations had assets under management worth about 380 million stg.
He added that the unit had also posted a 1996 premium income of approximately 126 million stg.
The deal is the first major move by Old Mutual International since it announced a restructuring of its international retail operations in December.

The firm is now acquiring all the existing policies, assets and liabilities of the Isle of Man business. The unit will be rebranded as Old Mutual International (Isle of Man) -- a process aimed to be completed by the end of March.

The move brings the group's total client assets under management to 2.5 billion stg from more than 250,000 policy holders and gives the firm an expanded presence in South America, Scandinavia and Britain.

"This is one of a number of developments...which should allow the group to broaden substantially its appeal to offshore investors during the course of 1997," said Frits Vleggaar, executive director of Old Mutual International group.
